app_description: On this page you can enter growth data and visualise it in comparison to a reference population. Please select the reference values to be used first and then enter sex, date of birth and the measured values to be visualised. The values are displayed in the graphics on the right (or below for mobile device users). Click on 'Height', 'Weight', and 'BMI' to switch between the different graphics. With the buttons at the bottom you can import existing data or export your entries and present them, for instance, to your family doctor.
privacy_note: The data entered on this page remains exclusively on your terminal device. Neither operators of this application nor other parties have access to your data at any time.
normal_turkish_germany: Germany (Turkish descent born, without chronic diseases)
target_height_description:
The target height is a rough estimation of the final hight your child might reach.
It is derived from father and mother height.
